tool_input.command:
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(hook): RefuseIfSessionGone refuses only on a genuinely absent roster (P1, PR #509 tail #7, G1)

Store.Load fails for two different reasons -- a missing roster file
(os.ErrNotExist) or a present-but-corrupt one (yaml.Unmarshal error) --
and RefuseIfSessionGone treated both as proof the session had ended.
Only absence is evidence of the undiscoverable-sidecar hazard this
check exists to prevent; a corrupt roster is exactly what
List()/Purge() would still find on disk. Every non-ErrNotExist error
now warns to stderr and lets the write proceed, matching the
"unresolvable is not stale" doctrine staleBindingReason already
applies to a contract that fails to load.

Confirmed failing against the pre-fix code: a corrupt-but-present
roster refused the mission-create pending-dispatch write with "no
longer exists" and left no entry on disk.
EOF
)"
